ko: 대학생인 내 동생은 과외로 시간을 내어 틈틈이 자원봉사를 한다.
wrong_en: My younger sibling, a college student, makes time for private tutoring and does volunteer work in spare moments.
fixed_en: My younger sibling, a college student, makes extra time on the side to do volunteer work whenever possible.

ko: 형은 술을 너무 마시다가 술독 증상으로 병원에 갔다.
wrong_en: My older brother drank too much and went to the hospital with symptoms of an alcohol-related skin condition.
fixed_en: My older brother drank too much and went to the hospital with a blotchy, flushed face from alcohol.

ko: 촬영 팀은 영화 후반부의 신을 찍기 위해 카메라와 장비를 야외 세트로 옮겼다.
wrong_en: To film the latter part of the movie, the film crew moved the cameras and equipment to an outdoor set.
fixed_en: To film a scene from the latter part of the movie, the crew moved the cameras and equipment to an outdoor set.

ko: 당첨이 무효화돼서 받은 당첨금 모두를 되돌려 주게 되었다.
wrong_en: Because the winning was invalidated, everyone who had received the prize money had to return it.
fixed_en: Because the win was invalidated, all the prize money received had to be returned.

ko: 나는 가슴이 마구 뚝딱뚝딱해서 귀까지 먹먹했다.
wrong_en: My heart was pounding so hard that my ears felt numb.
fixed_en: My heart was pounding so hard that even my ears felt muffled.

ko: 한국의 남동 방향에는 일본이 있다.
wrong_en: In Korea, Japan lies to the southeast.
fixed_en: Japan lies to the southeast of Korea.

ko: 계속 구부정하게 앉아 있었더니 허리가 곱는 기분이다.
wrong_en: I have been sitting hunched for so long that my back feels cramped.
fixed_en: I have been sitting hunched for so long that my back feels bent.

ko: 여인의 붉은빛 치마 속으로 하얀 속곳이 살짝 보였다.
wrong_en: Under the red skirt of the woman, a white underskirt was slightly visible.
fixed_en: Under the woman's red skirt, white under-trousers were slightly visible.

ko: 지수는 남자들도 받기 힘든 훈련을 받을 만큼 강단이 세다.
wrong_en: Jisu has such strong resolve that she underwent training even men find difficult.
fixed_en: Jisu has such strong resolve that she can endure training even men find difficult.

ko: 날이 풀리자 서둘러 어선들이 바다로 고기잡이에 나섰다.
wrong_en: When the weather cleared, fishing boats hurried out to sea to fish.
fixed_en: When the weather turned mild, fishing boats hurried out to sea to fish.

ko: 가장 윗자리에는 어른이 앉고 아이들은 아랫자리에 앉았다.
wrong_en: The adults sat in the top seat, and the children sat in the lower seats.
fixed_en: The elder sat in the top seat, and the children sat in the lower seats.

ko: 경비행기를 조종하는 법을 배워서 하늘을 멋지게 나는 게 내 꿈이다.
wrong_en: I learned to fly a light aircraft, and my dream is to soar beautifully through the sky.
fixed_en: My dream is to learn to fly a light aircraft and soar beautifully through the sky.

ko: 아낙은 남편이 나무라면 말 한 마디도 지지 않고 뒤받아 대꾸를 했다.
wrong_en: The wife talked back without losing a single word whenever her husband scolded her.
fixed_en: Whenever her husband scolded her, the wife talked back, never yielding a single word.

ko: 김 씨가 푸석푸석 거칠어진 손을 내밀었다.
wrong_en: Kim held out a rough, swollen hand.
fixed_en: Kim held out a dry, rough hand.

ko: 사위 사랑은 장모라고 하더니 사돈은 김 서방만 보면 흐뭇한 미소를 지었다.
wrong_en: They say a mother-in-law dotes on her son-in-law, but his in-law smiled warmly every time he saw Mr. Kim.
fixed_en: They say a mother-in-law dotes on her son-in-law, and sure enough, the in-law smiled warmly whenever they saw Mr. Kim.

ko: 소나기가 내린 날이면 유실물 보관소에는 사람들이 챙겨 가지 못한 우산이 가득했다.
wrong_en: On the day of a sudden shower, the lost-and-found storage was full of umbrellas that people had not taken home.
fixed_en: On days when a sudden shower fell, the lost-and-found office was full of umbrellas that people had not taken home.

ko: 음산한 구름이 칙칙하게 깔려 있는 하늘이 오늘따라 유난히 어두워 보였다.
wrong_en: Under a sky spread with gloomy, dingy clouds, everything looked especially dark today.
fixed_en: The sky, spread with gloomy, dingy clouds, looked especially dark today.

ko: 부부 동반 모임에 나타난 친구 부부는 닭살 애정을 과시했다.
wrong_en: The friend who appeared at the couples' gathering showed off the lovey-dovey affection of a couple.
fixed_en: My friend and their spouse, who showed up at the couples' gathering, flaunted their lovey-dovey affection.

ko: 박 의원의 활동은 지지자들의 찬동을 얻었다.
wrong_en: Assemblyman Park’s activities won the approval of supporters.
fixed_en: Lawmaker Park's activities won the approval of supporters.

ko: 지수는 엄마와 함께 옷을 사러 아웃렛에 갔다.
wrong_en: Jisu went to an outlet with the mother to buy clothes.
fixed_en: Jisu went to an outlet with her mom to buy clothes.

ko: 동생에게 화를 내다가 스스로의 모습에 멈칫 놀라 엉엉 우는 동생에게 사과를 했다.
wrong_en: I got angry at my younger sibling, and then, startled by my own appearance, I apologized to them as they cried loudly.
fixed_en: I got angry at my younger sibling, then, startled at how I was acting, apologized to them as they cried loudly.

ko: 남자는 연인에게 귓속말로 사랑을 속삭거렸다.
wrong_en: The man whispered his love to his lover into her ear.
fixed_en: The man whispered his love into his lover's ear.

ko: 동업을 하는 친구와 나는 이익을 일대일로 나누기로 했다.
wrong_en: My friend and I, who run a business together, decided to split the profits one-on-one.
fixed_en: My friend and I, who run a business together, decided to split the profits fifty-fifty.

ko: 적군은 우리의 무장을 해제하고 우리가 가진 무기들을 모두 빼앗아 갔다.
wrong_en: The enemy disarmed our weapons and took away all the weapons we had.
fixed_en: The enemy disarmed us and took away all the weapons we had.

ko: 그 여자가 악을 쓰며 날뛰는 모습은 마치 발작하는 광인같이 보였다.
wrong_en: The way that woman screamed and raged looked like a madman having a seizure.
fixed_en: The way that woman screamed and raged looked like a lunatic having a seizure.

ko: 책 속의 주인공이 너무나 가엾어서 책을 읽는 내내 슬피 울었다.
wrong_en: The heroine of the book was so pitiful that I cried sadly the whole time I read it.
fixed_en: The main character in the book was so pitiful that I cried sadly the whole time I read it.

ko: 가족들은 과년한 큰딸을 결혼시키기 위해 노력했다.
wrong_en: The family worked hard to marry off their eldest daughter, who had reached marriageable age.
fixed_en: The family worked hard to marry off their eldest daughter, who was past marriageable age.

ko: '비행기 태운다’는 말은 남을 지나치게 칭찬한다는 의미의 관용어이다.
wrong_en: The expression 'to fly someone's airplane' is an idiom meaning to excessively praise someone.
fixed_en: The expression 'to give someone an airplane ride' is an idiom meaning to praise someone excessively.

ko: 김 과장은 사장이 시키는 일이라면 도둑질도 할 만큼 그를 광신하였다.
wrong_en: Manager Kim so fanatically idolized the president that he would even steal if the president asked him to.
fixed_en: Section Chief Kim idolized the company president so fanatically that they would even steal if he told them to.

ko: 나는 같은 잘못을 반복해서 괘씸죄까지 뒤집어썼다.
wrong_en: Because I repeated the same mistake, I was even charged with the offense of being insolent.
fixed_en: Because I repeated the same mistake, I even fell out of favor for being insolent.

ko: 구개음화 현상의 예로 부사 ‘같이’의 발음이 [가치]로 나는 것을 들 수 있다.
wrong_en: An example of palatalization is the adverb 'gati,' which is pronounced [gachi].
fixed_en: An example of palatalization is the adverb gachi ('together'), spelled as if gati but pronounced [gachi].

ko: 아이는 병든 어머니를 대신해서 길거리로 구걸하러 나섰다.
wrong_en: The child went out onto the street to beg in place of his sick mother.
fixed_en: The child went out onto the street to beg in place of their sick mother.

ko: 가난했던 시절에 대한 아저씨의 이야기는 구구절절이 안타까웠다.
wrong_en: The uncle's story about the poverty of his youth was heartbreaking in every word.
fixed_en: The man's story about the days when he was poor was heartbreaking in every word.

ko: 화단의 흙에서 지렁이가 구불대며 기어가는 모습이 보였다.
wrong_en: In the flower bed soil, I saw an earthworm crawling along in wriggles.
fixed_en: In the flower bed soil, I saw an earthworm wriggling along.

ko: 지수는 떼쓰는 아이에게 말을 잘 들으면 사탕을 주겠다고 구슬렸다.
wrong_en: Jisu coaxed the whining child by promising to give him candy if he behaved.
fixed_en: Jisu coaxed the whining child by promising them candy if they behaved.

ko: 끈에 묶은 돌을 돌릴 때 그 돌에는 구심성이 생겨 바깥쪽으로 날아가지 않는다.
wrong_en: When a stone tied to a string is swung around, it acquires centripetality and does not fly outward.
fixed_en: When a stone tied to a string is swung around, a centripetal pull acts on it, so it does not fly outward.

ko: 바람이 불자 기다란 커튼 자락이 굼실대며 흔들린다.
wrong_en: When the wind blew, the long curtain panels swayed and wriggled.
fixed_en: When the wind blew, the long curtain panels swayed with slow, rippling movements.

ko: 지수는 선생님을 만나면 예의 바르게 허리를 굽실대며 인사했다.
wrong_en: Whenever she met her teacher, Jisu bowed politely and greeted him with a deferential bow.
fixed_en: Whenever she met her teacher, Jisu bowed deferentially and greeted them politely.

ko: 나는 마음이 썩어 뭉그러지고 굽죄여서 아무 말도 못했다.
wrong_en: My heart was rotting and I felt so overawed that I could not say a word.
fixed_en: Heartsick and utterly overawed, I could not say a word.

ko: 가부장적 권위주의가 지배하는 우리 집에서는 아버지의 말씀에 대든다는 것은 상상도 못 할 일이다.
wrong_en: In our house, where patriarchal authoritarianism reigns, talking back to my father's words is unimaginable.
fixed_en: In our house, where patriarchal authoritarianism reigns, talking back to my father is unimaginable.

ko: 우리 부부는 권태기를 극복하기 위해 둘만의 여행을 떠났다.
wrong_en: To overcome our period of marital boredom, my husband and I set off on a trip, just the two of us.
fixed_en: To get over a rut in our marriage, my spouse and I went on a trip, just the two of us.

ko: 백만 명 이상의 시민들이 모여 독재자를 물러나게 하기 위한 궐기 대회를 열었다.
wrong_en: More than a million citizens gathered and held a rally of uprising to force the dictator out.
fixed_en: More than a million citizens gathered and held a mass protest rally to force the dictator out.

ko: 내 동생은 눈을 반짝이며 내 말을 귀담아들었다.
wrong_en: My younger sibling listened carefully to what I said, his eyes sparkling.
fixed_en: My younger sibling listened carefully to what I said, their eyes sparkling.

ko: 가을밤이 되자 귀뚜라미가 귀뚤귀뚤 하고 소리를 내며 울었다.
wrong_en: On an autumn night, the crickets chirped kwi-ttul kwi-ttul.
fixed_en: On an autumn night, the crickets chirped, gwittul gwittul.

ko: 나는 해마다 명절이면 한복을 곱게 차려입고 귀밑머리를 했다.
wrong_en: Every year on holidays, I dressed neatly in a hanbok and styled my hair by my ears.
fixed_en: Every year on holidays, I dressed neatly in a hanbok and braided my hair behind my ears in the traditional style.

ko: 사내는 귀신같은 사격 솜씨로 모든 목표물을 명중시켰다.
wrong_en: With his demon-like marksmanship, the man hit every target.
fixed_en: With his uncanny marksmanship, the man hit every target.

ko: 그는 죽은 아내가 아끼던 목걸이를 딸에게 물려주면서 귀중히 간직하라고 당부했다.
wrong_en: He handed down his late wife's cherished necklace to his daughter and urged her to keep it preciously.
fixed_en: He handed down his late wife's cherished necklace to his daughter and urged her to treasure it.

ko: 승규네 부부의 이혼을 두고 이웃들은 그러니저러니 수군댔다.
wrong_en: The neighbors whispered this and that about the divorce of Seunggyu's couple.
fixed_en: The neighbors whispered this and that about Seunggyu and his wife getting divorced.

ko: 아이는 엄마와 떨어지기 싫은지 엄마를 그러안고 울면서 떼를 썼다.
wrong_en: Unwilling to be separated from her, the child clung to his mother, crying and throwing a tantrum.
fixed_en: Unwilling to be separated from her, the child clung to their mother, crying and throwing a tantrum.

ko: 그 집안은 형제가 모두 셋인데 그만그만한 형편으로 특별히 잘사는 사람은 없었다.
wrong_en: That family has three brothers, all in roughly similar circumstances, and none of them is especially well off.
fixed_en: That family has three siblings, all in roughly similar circumstances, and none of them is especially well off.

ko: 동생은 울음을 참았지만 그예 눈물이 뚝 떨어졌다.
wrong_en: My younger sibling held back the crying, but in the end a tear dropped.
fixed_en: My younger sibling tried to hold back tears, but in the end a tear fell.

ko: 두 남녀는 서로 그윽이 바라보았다.
wrong_en: The two lovers gazed at each other with deep tenderness.
fixed_en: The man and the woman gazed at each other tenderly.

ko: 기업은 이윤의 극대를 목적으로 한다.
wrong_en: A company aims at the maximum of its profits.
fixed_en: A company aims to maximize its profits.

ko: 성공한 기업가의 일생이 극화를 통해 한 편의 영화로 탄생했다.
wrong_en: The life of a successful entrepreneur was dramatized and born as a single film.
fixed_en: The life of a successful entrepreneur was dramatized and made into a film.

ko: 이 그릇은 금속제 그릇이라 깨지거나 상하지 않는다.
wrong_en: This bowl is made of metal, so it will not break or spoil.
fixed_en: This bowl is made of metal, so it will not break or get damaged.

ko: 유민이는 손재주가 좋아 친구들에게 금손으로 불린다.
wrong_en: Yumin is so handy with her hands that her friends call her a golden hand.
fixed_en: Yumin is so skilled with her hands that her friends say she has magic hands.

ko: 그는 올림픽 삼 연패의 금자탑을 세웠다.
wrong_en: He built a monument of achievement by winning three Olympic titles in a row.
fixed_en: He achieved the monumental feat of winning three consecutive Olympic titles.

ko: 갑작스러운 기온의 급강하 때문에 감기 환자들이 속출하고 있다.
wrong_en: Because of the sudden drop in temperature, cold patients are appearing one after another.
fixed_en: Because of the sudden drop in temperature, people are coming down with colds one after another.

ko: 화재 신고가 들어오자 구조대원들은 신고 장소로 급거 출동하였다.
wrong_en: When a fire report came in, the rescue workers hurriedly dispatched to the reported location.
fixed_en: When a fire report came in, the rescue workers rushed to the reported location.

ko: 건물이 기공된 지 삼 년이 지났지만 아직도 완성되지 못했다.
wrong_en: Three years have passed since the building broke ground, yet it still has not been completed.
fixed_en: Three years have passed since ground was broken for the building, yet it still has not been completed.

ko: 그 기자는 국가 기관원을 사칭하며 출입 제한 구역까지 취재하였다.
wrong_en: That reporter posed as a national intelligence agent and covered news even in restricted areas.
fixed_en: That reporter posed as a government agent and gathered news even in restricted areas.

ko: 민준이는 별다른 능력은 없지만 머리 하나는 기똥차게 좋다.
wrong_en: Minjun has no special abilities, but his brain is terrifically good.
fixed_en: Minjun has no special abilities, but he is incredibly smart.

ko: 지수는 다이어트를 하느라 기름기를 뺀 고기만 먹었다.
wrong_en: Jisu, on a diet, ate only lean meat with the oil removed.
fixed_en: Jisu, on a diet, ate only meat with the fat trimmed off.

ko: 유학을 떠난 친구에게서 아무런 기별도 오지 않아서 그가 어떻게 지내는지 모르겠다.
wrong_en: No word has come from my friend who left to study abroad, so I do not know how he is doing.
fixed_en: No word has come from my friend who left to study abroad, so I do not know how they are doing.

ko: 민준이는 기왕지사로 회장을 맡게 된 마당에 임기 동안 열심히 하겠노라고 이야기했다.
wrong_en: Since he had become chairman through the events of the past, Minjun said he would work hard throughout his term.
fixed_en: Now that he had taken on the chairmanship anyway, Minjun said he would work hard throughout his term.

ko: 노인은 힘든 일을 하다가 기함을 하여 몸져눕고 말았다.
wrong_en: The old man lost strength while doing hard labor and ended up bedridden.
fixed_en: The old man collapsed while doing hard labor and ended up bedridden.

ko: 나는 해외여행 중에 길동무를 만나 그와 함께 유럽 전역을 여행했다.
wrong_en: During my overseas trip, I met a travel companion and traveled with him across all of Europe.
fixed_en: During my overseas trip, I met a travel companion and traveled with them across Europe.

ko: 시험에서 낙방한 내 미래는 마치 깜깜절벽처럼 느껴졌다.
wrong_en: After failing the exam, my future felt like a pitch-black cliff.
fixed_en: After failing the exam, my future felt as bleak as pitch darkness.

ko: 아이가 낮잠에서 깨나 엄마를 찾으며 울었다.
wrong_en: The child woke from his nap and cried, looking for his mother.
fixed_en: The child woke from their nap and cried, looking for their mother.

ko: 나는 간장에 무친 깻잎 반찬을 좋아한다.
wrong_en: I love side dishes of sesame leaves seasoned with soy sauce.
fixed_en: I like side dishes of perilla leaves seasoned with soy sauce.

ko: 박 부장은 이 사업을 총괄하여 지휘하고 있다.
wrong_en: Section Chief Park is overseeing and directing this entire project.
fixed_en: Department Head Park is overseeing and directing this entire project.

ko: 김 씨는 컴퓨터 프로그램의 저작권을 침해한 혐의로 벌금을 물었다.
wrong_en: Mr. Kim paid a fine on suspicion of infringing the copyright of a computer program.
fixed_en: Kim paid a fine on charges of infringing the copyright of a computer program.

ko: 경찰은 구속 영장 발부와 동시에 범인인 김 씨를 즉시 구속하였다.
wrong_en: The police immediately detained Mr. Kim, the culprit, at the same time that the arrest warrant was issued.
fixed_en: The police immediately detained Kim, the culprit, as soon as the arrest warrant was issued.

ko: 검찰은 주가 조작 혐의로 구속된 그에 대하여 사법 처리를 검토하기로 하였다.
wrong_en: The prosecution decided to review judicial proceedings against them, who was detained on charges of stock manipulation.
fixed_en: The prosecution decided to consider legal action against him, as he had been arrested on charges of stock manipulation.

ko: 김 대리는 어머니 수술비를 마련하기 위해 회사에 가불을 신청했다.
wrong_en: Assistant Manager Kim applied to the company for an advance payment to raise money for his mother's surgery.
fixed_en: Assistant Manager Kim applied to the company for a salary advance to pay for their mother's surgery.

ko: 김 화백은 예술성이 뛰어난 가작을 많이 남긴 화가였다.
wrong_en: Mr. Kim was a painter who left behind many excellent works of outstanding artistic quality.
fixed_en: Kim, the painter, left behind many fine works of outstanding artistic quality.

ko: 헌법 재판소는 김 모 씨가 제기한 헌법 소원에 대해 청구 자체가 부적합하다며 각하하였다.
wrong_en: The Constitutional Court dismissed the constitutional complaint filed by Mr. Kim, saying the claim itself was improper.
fixed_en: The Constitutional Court dismissed the constitutional complaint filed by a certain Kim, saying the claim itself was improper.

ko: 어머니는 밥이랑 먹어도 싱겁지 않도록 나물을 간간하게 무쳤다.
wrong_en: Mother seasoned the namul lightly so that it would not be bland even when eaten with rice.
fixed_en: Mother seasoned the namul pleasantly salty so that it would not taste bland even when eaten with rice.
